definitions.gloss: senbu: the day of the rokuyō cycle when afternoons are lucky
definitions.explanation: One of the six days of the traditional rokuyō calendar cycle. The morning is considered unlucky and the afternoon lucky; the name suggests that hurrying ahead brings defeat, so it is a day for staying calm and doing things later.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{先負|せんぶ}だ。

examples.english: They say the afternoon is the good time on a senbu day.

examples.japanese: {先負|せんぶ}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{納車|のうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧にして⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: Since it was a senbu day, I had the car delivered in the afternoon.

notes:
Also read さきまけ or せんまけ. {先|さき}んずれば⟦{負|ま}ける→負ける：01134_makeru⟧ (go first and you lose) is the usual explanation of the name. The day after {先負|せんぶ} is ⟦{仏滅|ぶつめつ}→仏滅：16754_butsumetsu⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{先勝|せんしょう}→先勝：33308_senshou⟧: the opposite pattern, with lucky mornings
- ⟦{大安|たいあん}→大安：16753_taian⟧: lucky all day, the favorite day for weddings
